# muxt check passes html/template comments a browser and html/template
# both strip, comments in attribute values, <script> and <style>, a
# doctype, and any markup in a text/template set, which is text.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check --use-templates-variable=templates,prose

exec go build

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<title>Todo</title>
<style>/* <!-- kept --> */</style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- a comment -->
<!-- {{.}} is stripped, but it still runs -->
<!---->
<p title="<!-- kept -->">kept</p>
<script>/* <!-- kept --> */ if (1 <!x) {}</script>
<textarea name="note">a &lt;!-- b</textarea>
{{/* a template comment */}}
</body>
</html>
{{end}}
-- prose.txt --
<title>Todo<!-- draft --></title> <!x> <?x> <!-->
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
	text "text/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

//go:embed prose.txt
var proseFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "*"))

var prose = text.Must(text.ParseFS(proseFS, "prose.txt"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() string {
	_ = prose.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "prose.txt", nil)
	return "index"
}
